6551.title: Native goal states are rejected before projection
6551.rootCauseOneLine: Handwritten goal-status validators omit two native statuses, producing unhandled events and retaining the active projection; goal resume is absent from the supported control contracts.
6551.proposedFix: Align the native, extension, and public timeline status schemas, then design and wire a goal-resume action end to end without resetting usage.
6551.caveats: Repeated by the same agent in two clean trusted checkouts at 3bacfac9ed69d42392076e5b3da2815bec822cd8. Provider-boundary reproduction, not a live provider/server session. Reproduction test and output are inline in the report; no autopatch because public schema/API changes exceed the simple-fix policy.
